The rune-bearer's muscles bulge with the strength of a ferocious beast. The bearer can immediately [Step](/action/step-player-core) as a free action. The next unarmed [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) the bearer attempts before the start of your next turn deals an additional die of damage.

name: Removing Corruption
descr: The effects of [_soulforged corruption_](/rule/corruption-impossible-magic-rules-rules-3693) can be staved off with the Cleanse Soul Path exploration activity or cured with the _[purify soul path](/ritual/purify-soul-path-impossible-magic-ritual-ritual-243)_ ritual.

name: Rovan, Seal of the Dead Vault
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a creature

---

This mighty, jagged rune is just one of several that keeps the Destroyer sealed in his prison, deep in Golarion's core. The creature takes a –20-foot status penalty to its land Speed and a –40-foot status penalty to all other Speeds as the rune attempts to bind the creature. If a creature's [fly Speed](/rule/fly-speed-rules-2350) is reduced to 0 this way, it can't take the [Fly](/action/fly-player-core) or [Arrest a Fall](/action/arrest-a-fall-player-core) actions.

**Invocation**
([incapacitation](/trait/incapacitation)) The ground in the rune-bearer's space and in a 10-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387) becomes [difficult terrain](/rule/difficult-terrain-rules-2366) permanently, and the rune-bearer must attempt a Fortitude saving throw as the earth around it attempts to surround and imprison it. The rune-bearer is then immune to your _rovan, seal of the Dead Vault_ runes for 24 hours.

**Critical Success** The bearer is unaffected.

**Success** The rune-bearer becomes slowed 1 for 1 round.

**Failure** The rune-bearer becomes slowed 2 for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The bearer becomes restrained and blinded as it is trapped in a massive, compressed sphere of earth. While restrained, the bearer is also slowed 2. If the bearer is unable to escape the sphere within 3 rounds, it becomes petrified. Over the course of a year, the sphere forms a small hill around it, hiding its buried prisoner. At the top of the hill, a stone with the image of this rune remains. Counteracting the stone frees the prisoner.

name: Sar-, Diacritic Rune of Righteousness
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a rune

---

Clean arcs of gold faintly glow on the base rune, evoking celestial order and serenity. The base rune gains the [holy](/trait/holy) trait, as does any damage it deals. If applied to an [unholy](/trait/unholy) creature, that creature is [enfeebled 2](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) for as long as it bears the rune.

**Invocation**
When the base rune is invoked, it shines with holy light that harshly judges the target for any of its sins. In addition to the base rune's normal effect, the target is [drained 1](/condition/drained-player-core).

name: School of Breathtaking Influence
descr:
You have sway in powerful social circles and pride yourself on being able to predict and manipulate opponents. Less scrupulous academies openly teach this curriculum to aspiring politicians, while other colleges frame it as the study of countering mental manipulation. These spells are staples in Quantium, where ambition and ruthlessness are measures of success.

**Curriculum**
- Cantrips:
[Daze](/spell/daze-player-core), [Infectious Enthusiasm](/spell/infectious-enthusiasm-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2748)
- 1st:
[Command](/spell/command-player-core), [Fear](/spell/fear-player-core), [Sleep](/spell/sleep-player-core)
- 2nd:
[Blood Vendetta](/spell/blood-vendetta-player-core), [Phantom Crowd](/spell/phantom-crowd-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2787)
- 3rd:
[Enthrall](/spell/enthrall-player-core), [Mind of Menace](/spell/mind-of-menace-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2769)
- 4th:
[Confusion](/spell/confusion-player-core), [Outcast's Curse](/spell/outcast-s-curse-player-core)
- 5th:
[Subconscious Suggestion](/spell/subconscious-suggestion-player-core), [Wave of Despair](/spell/wave-of-despair-player-core)
- 6th:
[Dominate](/spell/dominate-player-core), [Never Mind](/spell/never-mind-player-core)
- 7th:
[Contingency](/spell/contingency-player-core), [Puppet Strings](/spell/puppet-strings-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2796)
- 8th:
[Dream Council](/spell/dream-council-player-core-2), [Hidden Mind](/spell/hidden-mind-gm-core)
- 9th:
[Telepathic Demand](/spell/telepathic-demand-player-core-2)

**School Spells**
- Initial: [Appeal to Authority](/spell/appeal-to-authority-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2920)
- Advanced: [Hot Air](/spell/hot-air-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2921)

name: School of Keen Inquiry
descr:
You’re a scholar of truth, seeking knowledge about the nature of existence and events past, present, and future. Whether you share or obfuscate that truth—best reserve judgment until you know what you’re working with. Quantium’s elite claim agents of Her Most Keen Eye, Nex’s network of spies, developed this curriculum, but it’s a staple in many politically oriented colleges.

**Curriculum**
- Cantrips:
[Detect Magic](/spell/detect-magic-player-core), [Sigil](/spell/sigil-player-core)
- 1st:
[Disguise Magic](/spell/disguise-magic-player-core), [Illusory Disguise](/spell/illusory-disguise-player-core), [Mindlink](/spell/mindlink-player-core)
- 2nd:
[Knock](/spell/knock-player-core), [See the Unseen](/spell/see-the-unseen-player-core)
- 3rd:
[Clairaudience](/spell/clairaudience-player-core), [Locate](/spell/locate-player-core)
- 4th:
[Clairvoyance](/spell/clairvoyance-player-core), [Detect Scrying](/spell/detect-scrying-player-core)
- 5th:
[Mind Probe](/spell/mind-probe-player-core), [Scouting Eye](/spell/scouting-eye-player-core)
- 6th:
[Scrying](/spell/scrying-player-core), [Truesight](/spell/truesight-player-core)
- 7th:
[Retrocognition](/spell/retrocognition-player-core), [True Target](/spell/true-target-player-core)
- 8th:
[Disappearance](/spell/disappearance-player-core), [Pinpoint](/spell/pinpoint-player-core)
- 9th:
[Foresight](/spell/foresight-player-core)

**School Spells**
- Initial: [Fact Check](/spell/fact-check-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2922)
- Advanced: [Unsettling Perspective](/spell/unsettling-perspective-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2923)

name: School of Nexian Spaces
descr:
Whether your goal is immortality or creating a world with every detail tailored to your liking, retracing Nex’s experiments with demiplanes is the road to achieving your desires. Your formal learning starts with reshaping your current reality and drawing power from other planes of existence. You graduate to creating extraplanar spaces and traveling between planes, making time and space yours to mold like clay.

**Curriculum**
- Cantrips:

name: School of Quantic Control
descr:
You’re an architect, but not merely of buildings. You call upon elemental forces to control the building blocks of reality itself, reshaping the environment and moving creatures like the world is a diorama for you to perfect. Your curriculum draws heavily upon the experience of the geniekin of Quantium’s Wish, who maintain the infrastructure of Nex’s capital in seeming defiance of physics itself.

name: Sertum, Rune of Preparedness
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a creature

---

The wavy lines of this rune evoke fields of reeds, the branches of trees blowing in the wind, or other natural phenomena. The rune-bearer gains a +1 status bonus to Survival checks and to Lore checks related to a type of terrain or specific natural location you choose as you draw the rune. The rune-bearer can use Survival to roll [initiative](/rule/initiative-rules-3300), and the status bonus applies to this roll.

**Invocation**
The rune reaches out to the surrounding terrain, shifting it to the rune-bearer's advantage. The rune-bearer can [Step](/action/step-player-core) up to three times as a free action.

---
**Level (9th)** The bonus increases to +2.

**Level (17th)** The bonus increases to +3.

name: Soul Path
descr: When you take Soulforger Dedication, you must choose a soul path—a motivation, cause, or goal that compels you to act and drives you to face significant danger. Such a motivation can be limited or grand in scope but must be actionable enough to be easily linked to gameplay. Work with your GM to choose a soul path that fits in well with the themes of your campaign and group dynamic, allowing you to pursue your soul path in an interesting fashion.

name: Soulforger
descr: Your devotion to a cause grants you the power to summon and wield a soulforged armament tethered to the very essence of your spirit.

name: Sparkling Targe
descr:
You've studied the applications of magic, training yourself to perform not just offensive maneuvers but defensive tactics as well. When magic flows through you, your shield can block impossible things, even a dragon's breath or a [_force barrage_](/spell/force-barrage-player-core).

 You gain the general [Shield Block](/feat/shield-block-player-core) feat.

 When you're in [Arcane Cascade](/action/arcane-cascade-impossible-magic-action-action-4261) stance with your shield raised, your circumstance bonus to AC from your shield also applies to your saves against spells and other magical effects. In addition, damage you take from a spell or other magical effect while you're in Arcane Cascade can trigger your Shield Block reaction, even if the damage isn't physical. When blocking damage from a magical effect in this way, increase your shield's Hardness by an amount equal to the resistance you have from Arcane Cascade. These benefits apply whether you're using an actual shield, the [_shield_](/spell/shield-player-core) spell, or something else that works like a shield (such as a raised tome if you have the [Raise a Tome](/feat/raise-a-tome-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9046) feat).

**Conflux Spell** [Shielding Strike](/spell/shielding-strike-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2882)

**Studious Spell (7th)** [Resist Energy](/spell/resist-energy-player-core)

**Studious Spell (11th)** [Warding Aggression](/spell/warding-aggression-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2860)

**Studious Spell (13th)** [Mountain Resilience](/spell/mountain-resilience-player-core)

name: Spirit
descr:
Spirit necromancers, also known as vitamancers, seek the secrets of the soul and play with the eternal energies of the living and dead. Your thralls often resemble ghosts and spirits.

**Grave Spell** [Life Tap](/spell/life-tap-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2900)

**Thrall Enhancement** Your thralls, while still being tied to the physical world, have an incorporeal essence. Whenever one of your thralls Strikes, you can choose for that damage to be spirit or void damage instead of physical damage.

name: Starlit Span
descr:
With magic, the sky's the limit, and you can't be bound by the confines of physical proximity. Your power reaches as far as your senses can perceive, transcending the space between you and your target even with spells that normally require direct physical contact.

 When you use [Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260), you can make a ranged weapon or ranged unarmed Strike, as long as the target is within the first range increment of your ranged weapon or ranged unarmed attack. This overrides the actual range of the spell.

 While you're in [Arcane Cascade](/action/arcane-cascade-impossible-magic-action-action-4261) stance, your ranged attacks ignore any [lesser cover](/rule/cover-rules-2372) your allies would grant to your target.

**Conflux Spell** [Shooting Star](/spell/shooting-star-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2883)

**Studious Spell (13th)** [Unfettered Movement](/spell/unfettered-movement-player-core)

name: Sun-, Diacritic Rune of Preservation
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a rune

---

This spiraling diacritic channels the magic of a rune outwards, then back to the same location, allowing a rune to reconstitute itself. After the base rune is invoked, the base rune automatically traces itself back upon the same target.

---
You can have only one copy of _sun-, diacritic rune of preservation_ applied at a given time, and once you invoke it, you can't Etch or Trace the Rune again for 10 minutes.

name: Thullax, Rune of Corrosion
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a creature or object

---

The swooping lines of this rune seem to melt into each other as if their edges were hazy and indistinct, though the meaning is clear to you. The rune-bearer's [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) to each physical damage type is reduced by 1 (if it has any such resistances). Its [immunities](/rule/immunity-rules-2313) are unaffected.

**Invocation**
The bearer takes 1d6 acid damage with a [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) Fortitude save; on a critical failure, it takes 1 [persistent acid damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core).

---
**Level (+2)** The reduction in physical resistance increases by 1, the damage of the invocation increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage increases by 1.

name: Ti-, Diacritic Rune of Fundaments
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a rune that deals acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage

---

This wavering diacritic encompasses the base rune to slightly change its meaning. When the base rune is invoked, you can alter the damage its invocation deals, choosing acid, cold, electricity, or fire.

name: Tilus, Rune of Vocabulary
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a creature

---

Upon close inspection, this rune comprises hundreds of smaller characters of various runic languages. When you etch or trace this rune, choose one language you know. The rune-bearer can speak and understand the chosen language and gains a +1 status bonus to Society checks and to Lore checks related to writing (such as Library Lore and Scribing Lore).

**Invocation**
The rune-bearer's voice rings clear and true, allowing them to automatically succeed at any [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278) that could disrupt an [auditory](/trait/auditory) action (such as the one imposed by the [deafened](/condition/deafened-player-core) condition) for 1 round. During this time, the bearer can also speak their true mind even if they are currently [confused](/condition/confused-player-core), [controlled](/condition/controlled-player-core), or otherwise unable to speak.

---
**Level (9th)** The bonus increases to +2.

**Level (17th)** The bonus increases to +3.

name: Trolistri, Rune of Forlorn Sorrow
descr:
**Usage** drawn onto a creature

---

This rune calls to mind the beauty hidden in sorrow. While this rune is beautiful, sorrow is best admired from a distance, discouraging approach. Enemies within 20 feet of the rune-bearer treat all spaces between them and the rune-bearer as [difficult terrain](/rule/difficult-terrain-rules-2366).

**Invocation**
Sorrow blots out the capacity for any other action. Each enemy in a 15-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387) around the rune-bearer must succeed at a Will saving throw or be [slowed 1](/condition/slowed-player-core) for 1 round as it spends the first action of its next turn sobbing (slowed 2 on a critical failure). Regardless of the outcome, the creature is then temporarily immune to the invocation of _trolistri, rune of forlorn sorrow_ for 1 hour.

name: Twisting Tree
descr:
The staff is perhaps the simplest of weapons, but this simplicity belies its elegance and versatility. To you, a staff is casting implement and martial weapon alike—the foundation of a fighting style.

 While you wield a staff in one hand, the staff adjusts in shape and weight, gaining the [agile](/trait/agile) trait and increasing its damage die size to 1d6. While you wield a staff in both hands, it lengthens, twists, and reshapes, gaining the [parry](/trait/parry), [reach](/trait/reach), and [trip](/trait/trip) traits.

 While you're in [Arcane Cascade](/action/arcane-cascade-impossible-magic-action-action-4261) stance, once per round you can [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) to change your grip on a staff as a free action.

**Conflux Spell** [Spinning Staff](/spell/spinning-staff-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2884)

name: Twofold Tine
descr:
Magic dances between the two weapons you wield with equally deadly grace. Fighting groups of enemies takes full advantage of your capabilities as you move from one foe to another.

 While in [Arcane Cascade](/action/arcane-cascade-impossible-magic-action-action-4261) stance, if you make a Strike with a melee weapon you're holding, you can intensify the stance's power for another melee weapon of your choice you're holding in a different hand. Until the end of your turn, any extra damage the chosen weapon gains from Arcane Cascade is increased to 2. The extra damage increases to 4 if you have weapon specialization or 6 if you have greater weapon specialization.

**Conflux Spell** [Force Fling](/spell/force-fling-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2879)

name: Ulgatus, Rune of Restraint
descr:
**Usage** drawn on armor

---

A faction of the constructed beings called automatons developed this rune to avoid the weaknesses of flesh. When the creature wearing the armor would gain or increase the value of their [drained](/condition/drained-player-core), [enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core), or [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core) condition, the rune attempts to prevent the imposition. The bearer attempts a DC 15 [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278). On a success, it doesn't gain or increase the value of that condition, but the rune goes temporarily dormant for 10 minutes. While dormant, the rune can't protect the bearer from conditions but can be invoked.

**Invocation**
The rune causes the armor to grow around the creature wearing it, fortifying any vulnerable spots. For 1 minute, the wearer gains [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 10 to critical hits.

---
**Level (17th)** The DC of the flat check decreases to 10 and the resistance to critical hits increases to 20.

name: Unarmed Attacks
descr:
Your eidolon starts with two [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) attacks. Each eidolon entry suggests some forms the eidolon's attacks might take, but since eidolons can have a variety of body shapes, you decide the specific form of the unarmed attacks (claw, jaws, horn, fist, and so on) when you choose your eidolon. Some eidolons' unarmed attacks might look like swords, clubs, or other weapons, even though they are extensions of the eidolon's form. Your choice of unarmed attack determines its damage type— bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing, as appropriate. Some of the suggested attacks list a typical damage type in parentheses, but you can work with your GM to choose a damage type that is right for your eidolon. Once you decide upon your eidolon's unarmed attacks, they can't be changed except via abilities that specifically change them, except with your GM's permission. Your eidolon has a primary and secondary unarmed attack.

 **Primary Attack:** Choose from the following statistics for the more flexible primary attack.

- 1d8 damage (choose one of disarm, nonlethal, shove, or trip)
- 1d6 damage ([fatal d10](/trait/fatal))
- 1d6 damage ([forceful](/trait/forceful) and [sweep](/trait/sweep))
- 1d6 damage ([deadly d8](/trait/deadly) and [finesse](/trait/finesse))
**Secondary Attack:** The secondary attack always deals 1d6 damage and has the [agile](/trait/agile) and finesse traits.

name: Undead
descr:
Your eidolon is an undead spirit pulled from the Ethereal Plane or the Void, embodied, and bound to your life force in an unusual, potentially antithetical way that even other summoners can't quite understand. Undead eidolons take about every imaginable shape and form, as their bodies manifest from their connection to you. Their ultimate form can be influenced by an amalgamation of the echoes and memories of their old life before becoming undead, their cause of death, their encounters in the afterlife, and portions of your own essences. Together, you and your eidolon need to explore the mysteries of life, death, and undeath to understand what your bond means for both of your futures.

**Tradition** Divine

**Home Plane** Ethereal Plane or Void

---

**Size** Medium or Small

**Suggested Attacks** claw (slashing), fist (bludgeoning), jaws (piercing)

- Str
- Dex
- Con 3
- Int -1
- Wis 1
- Cha 0
- AC ( Dex cap)

**Skills** Intimidation, Religion

**Senses** darkvision

**Language** [Necril](/language/necril)

**Speed** 25 feet

---

**Eidolon Abilities**

- **Initial** Void Essence
- **Symbiosis** Drain Life **Two Actions**
- **Transcendence** Rejuvenation

## Void Essence

Your undead eidolon has a link directly to your life force, which grants them a twilight state between living and undead. This renders them a living creature and therefore susceptible to many ailments that bother only the living, though they possess some resistances to these effects. The eidolon has void healing, meaning they heal from void effects that heal undead and are damaged by vitality effects that damage undead. They don't have an undead's normal immunities, but they do gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against [death](/trait/death) effects, [disease](/trait/disease), [poison](/trait/poison) effects, and non-damaging effects that target only undead. Additionally, their necrotic essence stanches their wounds easily. The flat check to remove [persistent bleed damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core) from the eidolon is DC 10 (or DC 5 after receiving particularly effective aid).

## Drain Life **Two Actions**

Your eidolon attacks a living creature and drains some of the creature's life force to feed your shared link. Your eidolon Strikes a living enemy. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC, with the following effects. On a critical hit, the enemy uses the result one degree worse than it rolled.

**Critical Success** No effect.

**Success** Your eidolon drains a small amount of life force. The enemy takes additional void damage equal to half your level.

**Failure** Your eidolon drains enough life force to satisfy itself. The enemy takes additional void damage equal to half your level and is drained 1. Your eidolon gains temporary Hit Points equal to the enemy's level, which last for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** Your eidolon drains an incredible amount of life force and is thoroughly glutted with energy. As failure, but the enemy is drained 2 and the temporary Hit Points are equal to double the enemy's level.

## Rejuvenation

Your eidolon's unusual connection with you allows you both to rejuvenate when defeated. The first time each day your turn begins while you're dying, you instantly regain a number of Hit Points equal to three times your level and wake up. (Increase your [wounded](/condition/wounded-player-core) condition as normal.) You can immediately [Manifest your Eidolon](/action/manifest-eidolon-impossible-magic-action-action-4267) as a free action. You can then take your turn as normal.

name: Upgrading, Reshaping, and Restoring
descr:
You might want to alter your soulbound armament by adding new runes to it, replacing its old form with a new one, or creating a new armament after yours was destroyed. When you do, it's up to you whether you consider this to be the same armament of the same lineage or a brand-new creation with a totally different appearance and name.

 Upgrading your armament works like [etching or transferring a rune or upgrading a permanent item from a lower-level version of the same item](/rule/runes-rules-3162), whichever is appropriate to what you're doing. You or someone else can do the work, but you must leave the item manifested for the entire process. You can transfer runes off your armament as well, typically in anticipation of establishing your bond with a different item.

 Reshaping your armament allows you to change the base weapon, armor, or shield into another of the same type, turning [half plate](/item/half-plate-player-core) armor into full plate, changing a warhammer into a longbow, and so on. If all you're doing is changing the form while keeping the same runes and other magical properties, you can do so by spending a day in meditation. This doesn't cost any gp or extra time unless the new form is higher than 1st level or unless the difference is so vast that the GM determines it might take additional time and cost. For example, turning explorer's clothing into full plate requires the same time, expense, and Crafting check as you'd need to Craft full plate since full plate is a 2nd-level item. Specific items can't be reshaped in this way unless the GM specifically allows it.

 You can also use this day in meditation to rebind your soul to a different item in your possession. Typically, you keep the old item, its power removed. Since the essence power you chose represents the effects of the connection to your soul, typically the essence power doesn't change when you bind a new armament. If you rebind your soul to an armament that can't accommodate your current essence power, you might also need to change the essence power. You can recreate a destroyed soulforged armament or bond to a new one if your previous one was destroyed. If it was destroyed by [_soulforged corruption_](/rule/corruption-impossible-magic-rules-rules-3693), you must first successfully use [_purify soul path_](/rule/removing-corruption-impossible-magic-rules-rules-3694). Recreating costs the same amount of time and money as creating the item from scratch. If you already have an item to form a new bond with, it takes 1 day in meditation, as with reshaping an armament.

name: Ur-, Diacritic Rune of Intensity
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a rune that deals damage

---

This diacritic accentuates the base rune with bolder lines to give greater weight to its effects. When the base rune is invoked, its invocation gains a status bonus to damage equal to 2 plus half your level.

name: Volatile Spark
descr:
Your crashing spells meet their match with booming gunshots in a magical fusillade. By modifying your shots with your magic, you create explosions and cut through defenses.

 When you use [Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260), you can make a ranged firearm Strike, as long as the target is within the first range increment of your firearm. This overrides the actual range of the spell. If your firearm has the [concussive](/trait/concussive) trait, any damage from the spell you use in the Spellstrike uses the target's weakest resistance to any of the following: the spell's damage type, piercing, or bludgeoning. This benefit applies only to creatures you target with your firearm Strike during the Spellstrike, so it wouldn't apply to other creatures damaged with Expansive Spellstrike or similar abilities.

 In addition, you gain the Reloading Cascade action.
 **Reloading Cascade** **Single Action** You use Arcane Cascade and [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) to reload a firearm.

**Conflux Spell** [Booming Blast](/spell/booming-blast-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2875)

**Studious Spell (7th)** [Entangling Flora](/spell/entangling-flora-player-core)

**Studious Spell (11th)** [Earthbind](/spell/earthbind-player-core)

**Studious Spell (13th)** [Seal Fate](/spell/seal-fate-player-core-2)

name: Xinsala, The Well of Virtues
descr:
**Usage** drawn on an unoccupied square

---

This complex rune comprises many different ligatures from the ancient Thassilonian runes representing the seven virtues of rule, before they were corrupted by the runelords. When drawn, it creates a well of glowing energy that occupies the square it's drawn on and creates an aura of swirling, virtuous runes in a 30-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387). While in the aura, you or any of your allies gain a +1 status bonus to AC against magic, a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic, and [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 10 to damage from magical effects.

**Invocation**
([healing](/trait/healing), [vitality](/trait/vitality)) The well explodes outward with invigorating force. The well heals any number of creatures in its area for a total of 70 Hit Points divided as you choose, and you and each of your allies in the area gain a +20-foot status bonus to your Speeds and are [quickened](/condition/quickened-player-core) for 1 round. The extra action from quickened can be used only to [Stride](/action/stride-player-core) or [Strike](/action/strike-player-core).

name: Yudici, Rune of Remonstrance
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a shield

---

This majestic rune grants the shield's wielder the conviction to aid their allies. While a shield bearing this rune is raised, its bearer emits an aura in a 10-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387) that grants their allies a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

**Invocation**
The shield regains 40 Hit Points, and all of the bearer's allies in a 10-foot emanation gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks for 1 round.

---
**Level (+3)** The Hit Points restored increases by 10.

name: Zohk, Rune of Homecoming
descr:
**Usage** drawn on a creature

---

This circular mark allows travelers to always find their way home. The rune-bearer gains a +15-foot status bonus to its Speeds, but only when its movement would end closer to you than where the creature started its turn.

**Invocation**
([teleportation](/trait/teleportation)) You call the rune-bearer to your side. You teleport the target to any unoccupied square adjacent to you. If the bearer is unwilling, it must succeed at a Will save to negate the effect.
